proposals.evidence: DEDR 2673 full article (p. 231) gives 2673 Ta. cuppal, cuppi twigs; uval, uvalai twigs and sprays, dried leaves. Ma. cappu leaf, esp. plantain leaf; tōl green leaves, small branches, shrubs. Kurub. (LSB 1.11) tovli leaves. Ko. Bhat cappu “leaf” matches Lindgren Koraga cappu “leaf” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
